cases.description: Three ducts get a comment in a rolled-back edit; after the value cache drops, the count of the rule Comments equals the comment, in both documents, follows the oracle
cases.expected: 0 before, 3 after, both equal to the oracle
manualSteps: Tick Current model and the link; Filter tab: + New filter, Categories Ducts, + Condition Comments equals mc-user-edit: count 0.
Select three ducts and type mc-user-edit in Comments: the count becomes 3 without a click in the panel.
Undo the edit: the count returns to 0.

cases.description: A duct is copied in a rolled-back edit; after the cache drops the Ducts count is one higher and equals the oracle
cases.expected: n before, n + 1 after, both equal to the oracle
manualSteps: Filter tab: + New filter, Categories Ducts, no rules: note the count n.
Copy one duct (Modify > Copy): the count becomes n + 1.
Undo the copy: the count returns to n.

cases.description: Two ducts are deleted in a rolled-back edit; after the cache drops the Ducts count is lower and equals the oracle
cases.expected: less than before, equal to the oracle
manualSteps: Filter tab: + New filter, Categories Ducts, no rules: note the count n.
Select two ducts and press Delete: the count drops.
Undo the delete: the count returns to n.

cases.description: One duct changes to a type of another family in a rolled-back edit; the rule Family Name equals the old family counts one less and equals the oracle
cases.expected: n before, n - 1 after, both equal to the oracle
manualSteps: Filter tab: + New filter, Categories Ducts, + Condition Family Name equals the family of one duct: note the count n.
Select that duct and change its type to another family in the Type Selector: the count becomes n - 1.
Undo the change: the count returns to n.

cases.description: An edit committed inside a transaction group and rolled back with the group (the API form of Undo): the count follows the edit and returns to the start value. Redo cannot run inside a run
cases.expected: 0, then 3, then 0 again, each equal to the oracle
manualSteps: Filter tab: + New filter, Categories Ducts, + Condition Comments equals mc-user-edit: count 0.
Type mc-user-edit in Comments of three ducts: count 3.
Press Ctrl+Z: count 0. Press Ctrl+Y: count 3.

cases.description: Eight evaluate requests for alternating documents, each new request canceling the previous one: no request fails except by cancel, the last one completes and equals the oracle, and a fresh count afterwards is still correct
cases.expected: last request = oracle, fresh count = oracle
manualSteps: Filter tab with Ducts: untick and tick the link and switch Current model and link quickly several times.
The panel settles Idle and the count shows the last choice.

cases.description: After the extra link Reload-Link was reloaded by an MCP step (scripts/models-context/user-action-reload.cs), the counts of every link equal the oracle and the Snapshot reload outcome follows the version rule: same version kept, small change patched, large change rebuilt
cases.expected: every document: panel = oracle; reload outcome = rule
manualSteps: Open Reload-Link in Revit, note the element counts per category, then reload the link from Reload-Link-small.rvt (Manage Links > Reload From).
In the Explorer the counts of the Reload-Link rows equal the file's counts; the panel stays responsive.
Reload from Reload-Link-large.rvt and back: the counts follow each file.

cases.description: In the active view, whose template controls V/G Overrides Model and Annotation (made by scripts/models-context/user-action-template-view.cs), Hide, Isolate, Halftone and Color on Current model elements, the link instance and a link category everywhere, each followed by Reset, then Hide and Keep inside a transaction group that is rolled back: no exception reaches Revit except the panel's own refusal, and Reset leaves the view as before
cases.expected: every action ok or refused with one message; after Reset no temporary mode, element and category overrides as before, the same template, the model not left modified
manualSteps: Duplicate the L3 plan, create a view template from it (View > View Templates > Create Template from Current View), keep every parameter included and assign it to the duplicate; open the duplicate.

In the Explorer use the eye, Isolate, Halftone and Color on a Current model category, on the link model row and on a category in the Categories box (its eye and menu); after each, click Reset in the temporary bar.
Each action works or the panel shows one line saying why; after Reset the view looks as before and Visibility/Graphics still shows the template's settings.
Hide a category, click Keep, then Undo: the view is as before.

cases.description: In the active plan, whose template controls V/G Filters (Snowdon HVAC L3 with 'Mechanical Plan'), Color on an Architectural door type (T4) puts one 'Model Context <n>' rule filter inside Temporary View Properties, where Revit draws it; Reset deletes it, inside a transaction group that is rolled back
cases.expected: the panel filter is on the view with a red override while Temporary View Properties is on; after Reset no Model Context filter is left, no temporary mode, the same template
manualSteps: Activate the L3 plan (template 'Mechanical Plan'). Explorer tab: tick the Architectural link, open Doors > a family > its type row, right-click > Color… and pick red.
The linked doors of that type draw red although the template controls Filters.
Click Reset: the color, the filter and the temporary mode are gone.
